mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates aggressive monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed cost of capital.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 0.1% (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% signals labor market slack that suppresses consumer spending growth, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with UNRATE > 6.0% (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 450000 indicate consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate profit growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances meeting HOUST < 1000 and RSAFS < 450000 (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output capacity and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days during supply shock regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with INDPRO < 100 (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals inflationary pressure that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with CPIAUCSL (y/y) > 2.5% (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: Higher retail sales (RSAFS) levels indicate stronger consumer spending momentum, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: RSAFS levels show no correlation with SPX 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with INDPRO < 100 (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate decline (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) and low CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL y/y < 2.0%) signal accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances meeting FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and CPIAUCSL y/y < 2.0% (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window).
